name: Registry operations
description: Enumerate keys/values, read or set typed values, create keys and delete leaf keys/values via StdRegProv. Set replaces existing values; deletion is not recursive.

subkey.description: Hive-relative path; empty root allowed only for enumeration

hive.description: Remote hive; use HKU with a loaded user SID instead of HKCU

name.description: Value name; omit only when default_value is true

type.description: Required for get/set; values lists stored types

data.description: Set: text, decimal/0x integer, JSON string array for MULTI_SZ, or hex bytes for BINARY
